accepted.s: Amaravati stupa is associated with which district in the current district arrangement?

accepted.tq: Distinguish current district names from older administrative references.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements is correct regarding the later development of the Amaravati stupa?
o: Its final enlargement was undertaken under the Ikshvakus, while Acharya Nagarjuna built its prakara.
Its final enlargement was undertaken by the Mauryas, while Ashoka built its prakara.
Its final enlargement was undertaken by the Sungas, while Kanishka built its prakara.
Its final enlargement was undertaken under the Guptas, while Hariti built its prakara.
accepted.x: The final enlargement is attributed to the Ikshvakus, while Acharya Nagarjuna is associated with construction of the enclosing wall or prakara.
